title: stuntdb configuration
description: stuntdb.yaml: which database to copy, where the copy goes, and how every column is masked.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors that read it from the file.

version.description: The configuration format version. Always 1 for now.

source.description: The database to copy. stuntdb only ever reads it.

url.description: The source database URL, such as sqlite:./app.db. Never write a password here: use an environment variable, as in ${STUNTDB_SOURCE_URL}.

max_connections.description: The most connections stuntdb opens to the source.

statement_timeout.description: The longest one query on the source may run, such as 30s or 5m.

to.description: The database URL to load the copy into, such as sqlite:./dev.db. The flag --to overrides it.

key.description: The secret masking key: at least 32 characters, from your secret store. Never write it here: use an environment variable, as in ${STUNTDB_MASKING_KEY}, or key_file.

key_file.description: A file that holds the masking key, relative to this file.

unclassified.description: What happens to a column that no rule covers. fail (the default) stops the run until someone reviews it; null and keep exist for experiments only.

not.description: Use key or key_file, not both.

columns.description: Masking rules: a table ("namespace.table", or just "table"), then its columns. A rule is a transformer name, such as keep or email, or an object with use: and the transformer's options.

transformer.description: A transformer name: keep, null, or one from stuntdb transformers.

domain.description: Columns in the same domain map equal values to equal fake values, so that joins between them still work. The default is namespace.table.column.
